description: This file is a shell script containing tests and utility functions for handling and verifying CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) encoding in git commit, branch, and tag messages. It defines functions to create references with CRLF line endings and tests to ensure git commands correctly process such messages.

methods.name: create_crlf_ref
methods.description: Creates a git reference (branch and tag) with a message containing CRLF line endings, extracting subjects and bodies from the input.

methods.name: create_crlf_refs
methods.description: Creates multiple references with different CRLF message configurations for testing.

methods.name: test_crlf_subject_body_and_contents
methods.description: Runs tests to verify that git commands correctly handle commit/tag messages with CRLF line endings.
